title: Open Values Register Observations
description: The facts a parser read out of one saved register download, as short labelled values that each point back to the raw record they came from. A register's parser writes it, and the evidence builder turns it into citations; it holds no scores and no finished sentences.

format.description: Names the file format. Always open-values-register-observations.

version.description: The version of this format the file follows. Always 1.0.0.

registerId.description: The id of the register the observations were read from. It must match the snapshot and the entity map.

snapshot.description: The one verified snapshot these observations were parsed from.

manifest.description: Path of the snapshot manifest, under pipeline/registers/raw/.

snapshotId.description: The snapshot's id. It must match the manifest.

payloadSha256.description: The SHA-256 hash of the snapshot payload the parser read. It must match the manifest, so observations from changed bytes are rejected.

parser.description: The parser that wrote this file. It must be the same id and version the snapshot manifest names.

version.description: The parser's version number, in major.minor.patch form.

targets.description: The catalogue options this snapshot covers, each written as cid/entityCode. Each must have a matched row in the register's entity map, and each needs exactly one observation. Listing targets lets several snapshots each cover part of one map.

observations.description: One observation per target option, keyed by that option's register identifier.

scheme.description: The kind of identifier, the same scheme as in the entity map.

value.description: The identifier itself, the same value as in the entity map.

id.description: An id for one raw record in the payload, unique within the observation. Claims cite records by this id.

pointer.description: Where the record sits in the payload: a JSON pointer starting with / or #, or line: or row: followed by a position in a text or CSV file.

label.description: A short name for the fact, such as Company complaint total. It is shown before the value in the generated note.

value.description: The fact itself as a single string, number or true/false value. No prose.

unit.description: The unit of the value, when it has one. It is shown after the value.

recordIds.description: Ids of the records this fact was read from. Each must be an id in the observation's records list.

registerIdentifier.description: The register identifier this observation is about, matching a matched row in the entity map.

outcome.description: records-found means the register returned matching records and the observation lists them with claims. no-matching-record means the search returned nothing; it then has no records or claims, and the generated note says this absence does not establish safety, quality or compliance.

searchTerms.description: The exact terms searched for, such as the legal name and product category. They are quoted in the generated note.

records.description: The raw records found, each with an id and a pointer into the payload. Empty when the outcome is no-matching-record.

claims.description: Single facts read from those records, each citing the records it came from. Empty when the outcome is no-matching-record.

outcome.description: Applies when the outcome is records-found.

records.description: A records-found observation lists at least one record.

claims.description: A records-found observation lists at least one claim.

outcome.description: Applies when the outcome is no-matching-record.

records.description: A no-matching-record observation lists no records.

claims.description: A no-matching-record observation lists no claims.
